heard: a three-ton stone lion flew over Beijing city walls. In 1626, the imperial Wang Gongchang gun powder armory suddenly exploded. The blast instantly flattened two square kilometers of the capital. A mushroom cloud rose and about 20,000 people perished. Strangely, the violent shock wave stripped many victims of their clothes. The Tianqi emperor fled his breakfast but his infant heir died. No one ever explained what launched the massive stone guardian.
